priorityReason: Primitive control counterpart to the existing extended add icon; required by counters, toggles, and zoom controls.
Common overflow-menu primitive; already covered by Solar menu-dots-vertical.
Generic async loading state; already covered by the existing Solar loader.
Common drag-and-drop handle; the three-dot grip family is simple to derive and useful in sortable interfaces.
Generic repositioning control; it can be derived from the existing maximize-square arrow geometry, with circle and square variants considered separately.
Common video-call state that completes the existing camera family while requiring a deliberate slash or disabled-state treatment.
Broadly used for assistants and AI features; Solar has no generic robot/assistant symbol, so the silhouette needs an original design.
Useful for intelligence, learning, and AI contexts, but more domain-specific than the primitive controls.
Common commerce and scanning primitive absent from Solar; the design needs controlled bar rhythm rather than a trivial modifier.
Useful inspection/search object with no Solar equivalent; it requires a balanced two-lens silhouette.
Common design and creative-tool symbol; paint-roller and palette do not preserve the brush object.
Useful developer, maintenance, and settings symbol; Solar has cases and boxes but no generic toolbox silhouette.
Common remote-work and video-interface object distinct from a handheld camera or videocamera.
Useful network-configuration compound; Solar has routers and transmission symbols but no combined Wi-Fi/settings state.
The shadcn registry uses this destructive archive state; Solar already provides the matching archive-close icon.
The current dumbbells candidate is not an interchangeable blocks or component-grid symbol used by shadcn previews.
The shadcn registry uses a vehicle example and Solar's transmission candidate is not a valid car fallback.
An eighteen-use progress and placeholder primitive is absent from the current Solar catalogue.
The shadcn registry uses the paste action in fourteen previews; a generic clipboard loses the action state.
The three-column layout control is part of the shadcn surface and has no accepted Solar equivalent.
The registry uses a generic container primitive that cannot be represented by a box fallback without changing the concept.
The file-chart-column compound is already covered by Solar file-chart.
This Lucide document-chart variant is already covered by Solar file-chart-2.
Five shadcn uses need a document-search compound; the current card-search candidate changes the base object.
The file-warning state appears in six shadcn previews and has no accepted Solar equivalent.
The folder-search compound is used in three registry previews and is absent from Solar.
The current video-frame candidate is too specific for the generic frame primitive used by shadcn.
The dashboard gauge is covered by the existing speedometer-low, speedometer-middle, and speedometer-max family.
The generic loader is used by shadcn independently from loader-circle; both need a stable Solar loading treatment.
Six shadcn previews require a question-mark message bubble already covered by Solar chat-round-question-mark.
Lucide's current layout alias appears nine times in shadcn and needs a deliberate panel-layout silhouette.
The generic square primitive is used as a fallback and loading shape throughout shadcn's icon renderer.
The favorite-off state is used in six shadcn previews and can share a deliberate state-mark family with other Solar controls.
The data-table primitive appears eleven times in shadcn; a bedside-table candidate is semantically wrong.
